title: Paranormal Cirque brings horror-themed circus to Spokane Valley this Labor Day weekend
excerpt: SPOKANE VALLEY, Wash. — If you're searching for an adrenaline-pumping way to spend your Labor Day weekend, Paranormal Cirque is bringing its unique blend of horror, cabaret and circus arts
content:
SPOKANE VALLEY, Wash. — If you're searching for an adrenaline-pumping way to spend your Labor Day weekend, Paranormal Cirque is bringing its unique blend of horror, cabaret and circus arts to town.

The traveling show set up its white and black Big Top tent at Spokane Valley Mall (14700 E Indiana Avenue) and will be there till September 7.

"It is thrilling horror, voodoo themed circus show that blends cabaret, acrobats, stunts, and much more," said Yury Belaus, a performer with the show.

The cast has been carefully selected from artists around the world and will showcase circus arts including the jaw-dropping Wheel of Death and intricate magic performances. 

Show times and tickets

Paranormal Cirque performs:

  • Friday, September 4: 7:30 p.m.

  • Saturday, September 5: 6:30 p.m. and 9:30 p.m.

  • Sunday, September 6: 5:30 p.m. and 8:30 p.m.

  • Monday, September 7: 7:30 p.m.

Tickets can be purchased online at paranormalcirque.com/tickets or at the box office outside the tent. The box office is open 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on non-show days and 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. on show days.

This show is designed for mature audiences. Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
